title: Read the verdict of a HiGHS log

blocks.text: A pumping-station operator runs its energy LP every night on HiGHS and keeps only the log. Their monitoring script needs the verdict from it: how the run ended, how much work it did, and the objective, but only when the objective is an answer.
Write `read_footer(log)` in `footer.py`. `log` is the list of lines a HiGHS solve wrote. Return a dict with three keys:

items: `"iterations"`: a dict from the kind of iteration to its count, read from each footer line ending in `iterations`, keyed by the line's first word: `Simplex   iterations: 7` gives `{"Simplex": 7}`. A run with no such line gives `{}`.
`"objective"`: the number after `Objective value` as a float when the status is `"Optimal"`, and `None` for any other status, even though HiGHS prints the line anyway.

blocks.text: The footer's labels are padded with spaces to line up their colons, so split each line at its first `:` and strip both sides, rather than matching exact spacing. Lines without a `:` are skipped.

"""Run executes this file. Change the calls and see what prints. Submit grades."""
import logging

# Turn the logger up, so the `log.debug` lines of your code show under the printed lines.
logging.basicConfig(level=logging.DEBUG, format="%(levelname)s %(message)s")

from footer import read_footer

optimal = [
    "LP tanks has 4 rows; 5 cols; 12 nonzeros",
    "Presolving model",
    "Using EKK dual simplex solver - serial",
    "Model name          : tanks",
    "Model status        : Optimal",
    "Simplex   iterations: 5",
    "Objective value     :  2.7500000000e+02",
    "HiGHS run time      :          0.00",
]
stopped = optimal[:3] + [
    "Model name          : tanks",
    "Model status        : Time limit reached",
    "Simplex   iterations: 900",
    "Objective value     :  1.9000000000e+02",
]
print("optimal log:", read_footer(optimal))
print("time-limit log:", read_footer(stopped))

from __future__ import annotations


def read_footer(log: list[str]) -> dict:
    """Read the verdict of a HiGHS log: its status, its iterations by kind, and its objective.

    The objective is an answer only when the status is Optimal; otherwise it is None.
    """
    # TODO: find the "Model status", "... iterations" and "Objective value" lines.
    return {"status": None, "iterations": {"Simplex": -1}, "objective": 0.0}


if __name__ == "__main__":
    demo = ["Model name          : demo", "Model status        : Optimal", "Simplex   iterations: 3",
            "Objective value     :  1.2500000000e+02", "HiGHS run time      :          0.00"]
    print(read_footer(demo))

cases.says: an optimal simplex log gives Optimal, its simplex iterations and its objective
a barrier log's iterations are counted under IPM, the word its footer uses
an infeasible log gives no objective, though it prints 0, and no iterations
an unbounded log gives its iterations but no objective, though it prints one

origin.section: A Failed Run's Objective Line Means Nothing

concepts: a HiGHS footer gives the status, the iterations by kind and the objective
an infeasible or unbounded run prints an objective line that is not an answer
